title: Help deciding which bits to include in gameplay video
author: Silent-Caregiver-242
selftext:
Hi, and apologies in advance, I know this still looks really rough and there are still bugs visible, but.

I do have a store page open and everyone says you should have at least a basic gameplay video available there, so I recorded the seven minutes of gameplay I have currently implemented, and I could really use help deciding which parts to include in the gameplay video.

I'm not asking for bug reports, I see the bugs myself too, you don't need to point out the current errors, I'm just asking for opinions on which parts of the gameplay you'd consider the most vital to have in the gameplay video.

The whole video is seven minutes long so I totally understand if you don't have time.

I will of course make a more polished gameplay video once the bugs are ironed out (and the final game mode, a square map one where you can move the characters individually, has been implemented and tested), but for now, I keep hearing that I should have at least some kind of gameplay video available there.

So if you can offer any help, that would be great.

comments.author: Silent-Caregiver-242
comments.body: I know I will re-record with the mouse pointer visible and the resolution turned down from 1080p to 720p so the text will look larger, so no need to point those out.

comments.author: DocHolidayPhD
comments.body: You do know someone owns the IP to Charlies Angels and will likely sue you for making any money off this, right?

replies.author: Silent-Caregiver-242
replies.body: It is a concern to think about, yes.
